metric_notes.primary: bt_score is computed after swap-stabilizing each unordered pair: unanimous A/B and B/A judgments keep the winner; disagreements collapse to TIE; TIE counts as 0.5 wins for each side.
metric_notes.secondary: bt_score_margin_weighted_secondary uses small/medium/large as 1.0/1.5/2.0 and is diagnostic only.
metric_notes.raw_ordered: bt_score_raw_ordered preserves the old 12 ordered judgments and is diagnostic only.
